issues.issue: The flagged '1' is part of the '≥1% higher than placebo' threshold descriptor, not an efficacy/safety data point; false positive.

The CV death HR text states '95% CI 0.80, 1.03' but labels it 'no statistically significant effect'; this is supported, however the result overstates by presenting HF-hospitalization HR 0.74 as 'the benefit reflected only reduced HF hospitalization' — this is supported, so acceptable; no actual unsupported numbers (dismiss).
Text says '6558 adult patients' but the cited quote states 6558; the primary analysis arm Ns (3241+3264=6505) do not sum to 6558, an internal inconsistency not explained.
Card text renders 'I_f inhibitor' but the citation quote reads 'I_t inhibitor'; minor transcription mismatch between field text and its own citation.
Phase field contains a description ('Outcome study supporting the HF indication') rather than an actual trial phase; mislabeled/non-standard value.
Summary states approval was 'based on the single outcome study SHIFT' but the cited quote notes 'three placebo-controlled outcome studies that are relevant,' overstating reliance on a single study.
